name: M3_PMS100MI_GetOperation
description: Retrieve the details of a single operation linked to a specified product, facility and manufacturing order. Obtains the full current definition of an operation, for example before updating it elsewhere or for external reporting and planning.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: OPNO
inputParameters.description: Operation number within the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center where the operation is performed.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: BAQT
outputParameters.description: Yield quantity reported for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: WOSQ
outputParameters.description: Reporting number identifying this operation within the order.

outputParameters.name: WOST
outputParameters.description: Status of the operation in the order lifecycle.

outputParameters.name: OPNO
outputParameters.description: Operation number within the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PCAP
outputParameters.description: Capacity type indicating whether machine hours or man-hours are used for this operation.

outputParameters.name: PLGR
outputParameters.description: Work center where the operation is performed.

outputParameters.name: OPDS
outputParameters.description: Short description of the operation.

outputParameters.name: QTHR
outputParameters.description: Quantity the operation can produce per time unit, indicating its output rate.

outputParameters.name: DEPT
outputParameters.description: Department to which the operation's work center belongs.

outputParameters.name: REAR
outputParameters.description: Planning area to which the operation's work center belongs.

outputParameters.name: PITI
outputParameters.description: Run time per price/time quantity used when planning the operation.

outputParameters.name: PTUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which operation times such as run and setup time are expressed.

outputParameters.name: CTCD
outputParameters.description: Quantity basis used for the operation's unit price and run time.

outputParameters.name: SETI
outputParameters.description: Setup time required before the operation can begin.

outputParameters.name: OSET
outputParameters.description: External setup time for the operation that can be performed while the machine is running.

outputParameters.name: FXTI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation's run time is fixed regardless of quantity.

outputParameters.name: PRNM
outputParameters.description: Planned number of machines used for the operation.

outputParameters.name: PRNP
outputParameters.description: Planned number of workers used during the operation's run time.

outputParameters.name: SENP
outputParameters.description: Planned number of workers used for setup activities for the operation.

outputParameters.name: ODBF
outputParameters.description: Lead time offset in workdays between the start of the operation and the product's finish date.

outputParameters.name: PRDY
outputParameters.description: Number of days the operation is planned to be in progress between its start and finish dates.

outputParameters.name: AUIN
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether automatic receipt is triggered when the last operation in the order, including this one, is reported.

outputParameters.name: AURP
outputParameters.description: Controls whether and how this operation is reported automatically based on reported quantities.

outputParameters.name: SCPC
outputParameters.description: Normal scrap percentage defined for the item in this operation.

outputParameters.name: WLDE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether finite capacity planning is used when scheduling this operation.

outputParameters.name: DOID
outputParameters.description: Document ID linked to the operation for related documentation.

outputParameters.name: TOOL
outputParameters.description: Tool number required to perform the operation.

outputParameters.name: PLLT
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the work center controls how lot numbers are created for this operation.

outputParameters.name: CRTR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation uses a critical resource that needs special monitoring.

outputParameters.name: LASK
outputParameters.description: Labor skill code required to perform the operation.

outputParameters.name: SWQT
outputParameters.description: Extra material quantity consumed as setup scrap for the operation.

outputParameters.name: CAMP
outputParameters.description: Number of labor tickets to be printed for this operation.

outputParameters.name: PIPR
outputParameters.description: Unit price used for costing and payroll for work performed in this operation.

outputParameters.name: WAFA
outputParameters.description: Time rate used together with the unit price when calculating the operation cost.

outputParameters.name: SEPR
outputParameters.description: Cost for the setup activities required before the operation can begin.

outputParameters.name: WCRF
outputParameters.description: Time reference code used to group this operation for scheduling.

outputParameters.name: KIWG
outputParameters.description: Pay element describing the wage type to apply to this operation, such as setup work or overtime.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number associated with this operation, for example for subcontracting.

outputParameters.name: INWE
outputParameters.description: Weight of the material in kilos before this operation is performed.

outputParameters.name: OPV3
outputParameters.description: Operation volume used as a cost driver in product costing.

outputParameters.name: MFPR
outputParameters.description: Multiplication factor used in manufacturing costing to neutralize unit differences for this operation.

outputParameters.name: OPCM
outputParameters.description: Multiplier used to adjust this operation's cost in product costing.

outputParameters.name: TXT1
outputParameters.description: Free text line 1 for additional information about the operation.

outputParameters.name: TXT2
outputParameters.description: Free text line 2 for additional information about the operation.

outputParameters.name: PLG6
outputParameters.description: Work center resource within the work center that performs this operation.

outputParameters.name: APON
outputParameters.description: Primary operation number used for scheduling and linking this operation with parallel operations.

outputParameters.name: NXOP
outputParameters.description: Number of the next operation in the routing sequence after this operation.

outputParameters.name: SLAT
outputParameters.description: Code defining how this operation overlaps or queues to the next operation.

outputParameters.name: SLAC
outputParameters.description: Overlap base value used together with the overlap code when scheduling this operation relative to the next.

outputParameters.name: POOC
outputParameters.description: Code controlling how this operation overlaps with its primary operation in scheduling.

outputParameters.name: RESR
outputParameters.description: Resource restriction value used to limit which resources can perform this operation.

outputParameters.name: PLGF
outputParameters.description: Resource that is fixed for use by this operation when it is scheduled.

outputParameters.name: PRET
outputParameters.description: Preparation time inserted between this operation and the next as part of inter-operation time.

outputParameters.name: POTM
outputParameters.description: Post-operation time inserted between the end of this operation and the start of the next.

outputParameters.name: SPLK
outputParameters.description: Method used to split this operation across multiple machines or parallel operations.

outputParameters.name: SPLF
outputParameters.description: Fixed rate amount that can be split into several partial invoices for this operation.

outputParameters.name: SPLN
outputParameters.description: Number of operations created when this operation is split according to the split method.

outputParameters.name: SPSZ
outputParameters.description: Quantity per split operation when splitting this operation by quantity.

outputParameters.name: ORQA
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: MAQA
outputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the manufacturing unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: SCQA
outputParameters.description: Accumulated scrapped quantity for the manufacturing order in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: SCRE
outputParameters.description: Reason code explaining why quantity was rejected or scrapped for this order or operation.

outputParameters.name: RETI
outputParameters.description: Remaining time in hours for the operation, calculated as planned time minus reported time.

outputParameters.name: UMAT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported labor run time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: UMAS
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported labor setup time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: UPIT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported machine run time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: USET
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported machine setup time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: STDT
outputParameters.description: Planned start date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MSTI
outputParameters.description: Planned start time of the operation.

outputParameters.name: FIDT
outputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MFTI
outputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the operation.

outputParameters.name: RSDT
outputParameters.description: Actual start date when the operation was first reported.

outputParameters.name: REFD
outputParameters.description: Actual finish date when the operation was reported as completed.

outputParameters.name: RPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the latest reporting transaction for this operation was performed.

outputParameters.name: WODP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether order documents have been printed for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: DPLG
outputParameters.description: Alternate work center where the operation was actually performed.

outputParameters.name: AMAO
outputParameters.description: Number of workdays material should be reserved before the operation start date.
